apps.name: NewPipe
apps.subtitle: 轻量流媒体前端
apps.localizedDescription: 开源流媒体前端，支持 YouTube、SoundCloud 等平台的播放与后台音频。

versions.localizedDescription:
上游源文件：NewPipe_v0.29.1.apk

This is a hotfix release that fixes media.ccc.de live streams. Happy hacking!

上游源文件：NewPipe_v0.29.0.apk

:warning: :warning: This release drops support for Android 5, see [this blogpost](https://newpipe.net/blog/pinned/announcement/drop-android-5/) and #13438 :warning: :warning:

### Fixed
- Fix SecurityException when opening downloaded files in other app #13391
- Fix playback not working after player enters idle state #13390
- Fix video playback when exiting popup to main screen #13437
- Fix repeat mode UI out-of-sync when switching videos #13504
- Fix crash when seeking to the end of special videos (again) #13594
- Force keyboard dismissal on non-touch devices #13337
- Fixed importing subscriptions #13608

### Translation / Localization
- Translation updates #13455, #13589
- Multi Platform Translation updates: #13588

### Development
- Update dependencies and plugins #13425 #13444 #13505 #13531 #13611
- Bump `minSdk` from 21 (Android 5.0) to 23 (Android 6) #13425 #13441
- Update dependencies and build with JDK 21 #13454 
- Introduce compose multiplatform #13507 
- Compose rewrite #13486 #13652

### NewPipe Extractor

This release comes with additional bug fixes from [NewPipe Extractor 0.26.4](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/releases/tag/v0.26.4).

上游源文件：NewPipe_v0.28.8.apk

This release fixes issues that were caused by YouTube enforcing its SABR protocol, **except for videos made for kids** due to a limitation of the workaround. Most notable were missing video resolutions, no separate audio stream available and the sole availability of MP4 360p stream with audio. This workaround is a community effort. Thanks to all the people involved! #13591

This release is shipped with [NewPipe Extractor v0.26.3](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/releases/tag/v0.26.3) which contains the mentioned workaround as well as a few other fixes, including no videos extracted on YouTube playlists and Bandcamp search returning no results.

上游源文件：NewPipe_v0.28.7.apk

This is a small hotfix update to make YouTube usable again. It is necessary, because there were changes by YouTube.
NewPipe is able to extract items in channel tabs again thanks to @AudricV's and @Ecomont's efforts.

Further changes from [NewPipe Extractor v0.26.2](https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipeExtractor/releases/tag/v0.26.2) that are included in this release:
- [YouTube] Fixed duration and live stream display in related videos
- [SoundCloud] Fixed comments crash by handling null page URLs

NewPipe will drop Android 5 support in the next release.

上游源文件：NewPipe_v0.28.6.apk

This release only adds a popup to inform users that the next version, *v0.28.7*, will **drop support for Android 5**.

Read more in the [blogpost](https://newpipe.net/blog/pinned/announcement/drop-android-5/) and in https://github.com/TeamNewPipe/NewPipe/issues/13438.
